'''Sha'lott''' was a nickname that was given to an [[ibbot]] that was flown by the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] [[Elamm]] during his duties as a member of the [[Wingriders]], an aerial [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. Sha'lott's name translated into the [[Language/Legends|language]] [[Drallish]] as "graywing."<ref name="CatCW" />
